title: Data Namespace
definition: A unique identifier that organizes and separates data within a decentralized network.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A way to keep different data organized and separate within a large network, like labeling each data set with a unique name or ID.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A unique identifier used within a decentralized network to organize and separate data, allowing for flexible experimentation and evolution of data structures.
difficulty_levels.expert: A system for organizing data within a decentralized network using unique identifiers, allowing for distinct data spaces and enabling evolution and experimentation within those spaces.

extra_fields.insight: Data namespaces promote a decentralized ecosystem by allowing for flexibility, experimentation, and evolution of data structures.
